name: One Piece: East Blue Brawls [BETA]
desc:
A Netflix Nextworld Experience

Based on the live action One Piece series - brawl endless waves of baddies in arenas across the East Blue and become the most feared pirate on Roblox. Join up to four other players and take on Luffy’s powers, or the fighting style of Nami, Zoro, Sanji, or Usopp. 

⚔️ Unlock attack combos for every character and increase your bounty the more you brawl with your favorite Straw Hat Pirate’s skills!

☠️ Level up to take on tougher enemies! Battle Marines & Captain Axe-Hand Morgan at Shells Town, circus baddies & Buggy in Buggy’s Tent, and fishmen & Arlong at The Baratie. 

💰 The best stats will find a place on the leaderboard and the highest bounties will be posted on the bounty board for all to fear or beat.

Created by Buoy Studios
